method: Best Sellers is a curation category, not a source of new products.
No products were imported for it. Existing catalogue products were given Best Sellers as an ADDITIONAL product_cat, so each keeps its original category.
Ranked by live AliExpress order volume (lastest_volume) pulled for all 67 catalogue products.
Capped at the top 3 per source category so the category represents the whole shop rather than only Dog Toys and Beds & Comfort.
Products below 90% positive feedback were excluded.
Re-run this ranking periodically; order volumes drift and the selection will go stale.
